title: Hadron Cua agent VM fixture descriptor
description: Frozen contract emitted by test/agent/run.sh fixture (Phase 4, Task 3) and consumed by the Go smoke client (Task 4) and downstream CI gates. Exactly these eight string fields, nothing else.

mcp_url.description: HTTPS URL of the gateway MCP endpoint, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:7443/mcp. Must be https and must end in /mcp.

bearer_token_file.description: Absolute path to a mode-0600 file containing the plaintext bearer token (hdn_u_... or hdn_a_...). Never embed the token value itself in the descriptor.

ca_certificate_file.description: Absolute path to the PEM-encoded self-signed leaf certificate captured via TOFU, for pinned TLS verification.

tls_fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the DER-encoded leaf certificate (64 characters).

vnc_address.description: Loopback VNC listen address in host:port form, e.g. 127.0.0.1:5910.

novnc_url.description: HTTP URL of the noVNC web console, or the empty string when noVNC is disabled for this fixture.

qmp_socket.description: Absolute path to the QMP control-socket Unix domain socket.

artifact_directory.description: Absolute path to the directory where this fixture instance writes logs, screenshots, and results.
